The two use cases as sequences; each step has the same number as in its
Use case 1 (mobile): “I had a car accident”, with photos
Steps 4-6 run in parallel: photos and documents go to Blob Storage (SAS URL), Event Grid
triggers the extraction job: Document Intelligence (documents), Content Understanding (photos).
high value → review task (via Claims MCP)
streamed reply: claim registered, under review
Use case 2 (web): “Is water damage from my neighbour covered?”
policy wording, filtered to this customer
answer + clause references + ‘talk to a person’
Telemetry: every hop emits OpenTelemetry spans
latency · tokens · cost · prompt version · eval score → App Insights, Langfuse
